activities.title: Electric field lines run from + to -
A bar magnet's field loops from N to S
Moving the magnet changes the flux
A generator spins the coil in the field

assessmentPoints: Field line answers in the electric field lines activity
successCriteria: Electric field lines run from positive charges to negative charges; magnetic field lines outside a bar magnet run from the north pole round to the south pole.
The field is uniform: E has the same size and direction everywhere between the plates
objectives.text: Describe electric and magnetic fields from their field lines: E from + to -, B looping from N to S

assessmentPoints: Flux and emf answers in the moving magnet activity
objectives.text: Compute flux with Φ = BA and induced emf with Faraday's law, emf = -N ΔΦ/Δt

assessmentPoints: Generator answers in the spinning coil activity
Trap answers in the toolkit activity
successCriteria: The emf follows the rate of change of flux, not the flux itself. As the coil turns edge-on the flux passes through zero but is changing fastest there, so the emf peaks; half a turn later the flux changes the other way, so the emf reverses and alternates with the spin.
No change in flux, no emf: the magnet sitting still gives zero - only motion makes the meter kick.
objectives.text: Explain the generator's alternating emf and avoid the sitting-magnet trap
